name: l2cap_signal_dispatch

ownership.argument: Submitted by 0xC805C40, which the receive path 0xC7FB318 calls. The dispatch table is the authoritative map from signalling code to handler on this build: 0x14/0x15/0x16/0x17/0x18 are the LE CoC codes.

provenance.source: Parses a received L2CAP signalling frame: element header is code at +0, identifier at +1, length at +2, and each element is dispatched through the 26-entry table at 0x2CD9F864 indexed by code-1, whose entry is {handler +0, minimum length +2 (u16), byte +4, flags +6}. Applies the duplicate-identifier check against channel+41 and builds a Command Reject (code 1, reason 5) through 0xC7EAFBC/0xC7FE4D0 when a code is unknown or too short.

notes: Submitted by 0xC805C40, which the receive path 0xC7FB318 calls. The dispatch table is the authoritative map from signalling code to handler on this build: 0x14/0x15/0x16/0x17/0x18 are the LE CoC codes.
